status: external inputs; fetched and hash-checked by fetch_inputs.py; ignored by Git
publication_note: Published tables for the colour of seawater. The NASA files are United States government works that redistribute the cited measurements; RELAB's spectra are public with a citation request. None is redistributed by this repository. A hash mismatch means the upstream bytes changed and must be reviewed, never silently accepted.

files.name: water_spectra.dat
files.credit: NASA Ocean Biology Processing Group, OCSSW common data, tag T2020.2: pure-water absorption from Pope and Fry (1997, Appl. Opt. 36, 8710) and Kou, Labrie and Chylek (1993, Appl. Opt. 32, 3531); pure-seawater scattering from Zhang, Hu and He (2009, Opt. Express 17, 5698) at 20 C and 38.4 g/kg. Cite the measurement papers.
files.use: Absorption and scattering of pure seawater

files.name: aph_bricaud_1998.txt
files.credit: Bricaud, Morel, Babin, Allali and Claustre (1998, J. Geophys. Res. 103, 31033): particulate and phytoplankton absorption as power laws of chlorophyll a from 1,166 spectra, 400-700 nm at 2 nm, as tabulated in NASA OBPG OCSSW common data, tag T2020.2.
files.use: Absorption by phytoplankton and the particles that vary with them

files.name: 12001Kdata.txt
files.credit: Apollo 12 soil 12001, Oceanus Procellarum, low-titanium mare. Lunar Soil Characterization Consortium bidirectional reflectance (RELAB, incidence 30 degrees, emission 0) of the <10, 10-20, 20-45 and <45 micrometre fractions, 300-2600 nm at 5 nm, as served by Brown University's RELAB (Taylor et al. 2001, J. Geophys. Res. 106, 27985; Pieters et al. 2000, LPSC 31, 1865; Taylor et al. 2010, J. Geophys. Res. 115, E02002 for the highland soils). Cite the consortium papers and RELAB.
files.use: Mare regolith fines suspended near the coasts
